summary: PT Telkom Indonesia filed a Form 6-K reporting that its 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders approved a change in management, effective September 30, 2026. The board was reshuffled: President Director Dian Siswarini was replaced by Nanang Hendarno, while Budi Satria Dharma Purba moved from Network to Wholesale International and Kharim I. G. Siregar became IT Digital; Radita Ali Putra joined as a director. The Board of Commissioners was reconstituted under President Commissioner Angga Raka Prabowo. The company states no material operational, legal, or financial impact. Watch for strategy shifts under new leadership.
